metas.name: 1 · ★ 7.2 · 2016 · Fantastic Beasts and Where to Find Them
metas.description: In 1926, magizoologist Newt Scamander arrives in New York during his worldwide tour to research and rescue magical creatures as something mysterious leaves trails of destruction in the city, threatening to expose the wizarding world.

metas.name: 2 · ★ 6.5 · 2018 · Fantastic Beasts: The Crimes of Grindelwald
metas.description: Gellert Grindelwald plans to raise an army of wizards to rule over non-magical beings. In response, Newt Scamander's former professor, Albus Dumbledore, seeks his help to stop him.

metas.name: 3 · ★ 6.2 · 2022 · Fantastic Beasts: The Secrets of Dumbledore
metas.description: Albus Dumbledore knows that Gellert Grindelwald is moving to take control of the wizarding world. Unable to stop him alone, he asks Newt Scamander to lead an intrepid team on a dangerous mission.
